content.en: Intellectual Property Rights refer to the legal protections given to creators. In the context of the **Indian Economy**, these rights are vital for encouraging **Research and Development (R&D)** and attracting **Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)**. The **World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO)** sets international standards, while India aligns its domestic laws with the **TRIPS Agreement** under the WTO.
